correctness.rationale: The join semilattice on three atoms gives exactly four free image values subject to f(0)∨f(atom)=f(atom); bilinearity of multiplication reduces all homomorphism tests to seven relation families on T,P,Q,R. One nonidempotent matrix mask 2 and seven idempotent masks give exhaustive finite branches: T=Q=0 has 15 solutions, T=0/Q=2 has one, nonzero T=Q has six constants and eight nonconstant strict-pair maps, total 30. Direct all 64 ordered-pair verification over all 8^4 candidates independently corroborates no omissions. Idempotents by map composition number 21, rank profile 7/12/1/1; unique rank-four idempotent is diagonal projection with order-two diagonal-swap local unit group; rank-one, rank-two and rank-eight images have trivial automorphism groups. Only binary (+,·) preservation is asserted; naming 0 or 1 would change answer.
